Question 7

What type of quadratic curve is defined by the following equation? x12−2x22+2x2=12

a
A hyperbola with semiaxes 13 and 12
b
A pair of intersecting lines
c
A parabola
d
A circle of radius 12
e
An ellipse with semiaxes 1 and 12
